title: CompiledRuntimeUnit.v1
description: The DETERMINISTIC compile of ONE promoted capability into a deployable RUNTIME UNIT — the per-capability analog of architecture/deploy_topology.json (which is the per-SERVICE plane). Produced by src/teleon/compiler/compile.py::compile_capability from a PROMOTED capability record (its spec + gate evidence + receipts); a non-promoted capability NEVER compiles (the only-promoted-compiles law). Pure + deterministic: identical inputs (incl. the passed-in now/hash) → byte-identical output. The runtime_class→backend binding is reused from src/teleon/purpose_tasks/runtime_binding (not reinvented); resources come from architecture/worker_resource_classes.json; budgets from the SLA policy + the OIPS budget_policy + the CapabilityTask spec (no magic values). LOSSLESS: the unit carries lineage back to the capability + receipt_refs + a rollback_target; it never discards the source. is_truth is structurally false — a compiled unit is a deployable plan, not served truth.

unit_id.description: stable id = compiler_version + capability_id + capability_version + exec_target + source_spec_hash, hashed (deterministic; daily recompiles of the same inputs collapse, a changed input does not)

capability_id.description: the promoted capability this unit deploys (lineage to the source — the unit is never decoupled from it)

capability_version.description: the capability record's committed version at compile time (which gate-passed iteration this unit pins)

runtime_class.description: the abstract OCTS runtime class the capability declared (from architecture/capability_runtime_classes.json); vendor-neutral

backend.description: the concrete backend the runtime_class bound to via src/teleon/purpose_tasks/runtime_binding.bind_allowed (a cloud/K8s vendor when credentialed+healthy, else the class's local equivalent — cloud-defer-only-after-local-equivalent)

exec_target.description: the concrete deployable shape emit() renders for. PORTABLE by construction: every unit can emit all three — fly_machine config (JSON), k8s Job (YAML), local process spec — so a capability is never cloud-locked.

binding.description: the full RuntimeClassBinding.v1 decision that produced backend (action/is_local_fallback/known_class/reason/considered) — lineage for WHY this backend, not just which

image.description: the container image ref (joined from architecture/deploy_topology.json image.registry_hint — single source, not typed here)

command.description: the capability runner argv (module entrypoint + capability id), so the unit is self-describing

env_refs.description: names of env vars/SECRET REFS the runtime reads — names only, NEVER values (defense in depth, mirrors the receipt sink's no-raw-secret rule)

cpu.description: cpu_request from the resource class (Kubernetes quantity, e.g. '500m','2') — joined, never typed

memory_mb.description: memory_request from the resource class, normalized to MB (Mi/Gi parsed deterministically)

max_tokens.description: model token ceiling from the OIPS resolved preference budget_policy (max_output_tokens|max_tokens); the platform default constant only when the policy omits it (recorded in budget_basis)

max_attempts.description: from the CapabilityTask spec max_attempts (its declared input) — the gate's retry ceiling

timeout_s.description: wall-clock ceiling = the SLA policy target_seconds (joined by sla_policy_id from architecture/worker_sla_policies.json), else the resource class timeout_default_s

budget_basis.description: WHERE each budget came from (policy id / spec field / default-constant) — honesty about the join, not magic numbers

otel_attrs.description: OpenTelemetry-shaped resource attributes for trace correlation (service.name, capability.id, capability.version, runtime.class, deployment.exec_target, teleon.unit_id, trace_id/span_id when supplied) — the 'standardization and logging tools' wired into every unit

train_pass_rate.description: the TRAIN split pass-rate from the promoting run (a gate input, not a claim of truth)

holdout_pass_rate.description: the HOLDOUT split pass-rate from the promoting run (the anti-answer-key-gaming split)

gate_basis.description: how promotion was judged (e.g. 'train+holdout' — both splits must clear PROMOTE_AT)

promoted_at.description: when the capability cleared the gate (passed in; never wall-clock-read inside the compiler)

status.description: structurally pinned 'promoted' — the only-promoted-compiles law made schema-enforceable

receipt_refs.description: ModelInvocationReceipt ids attached as provenance (model-call lineage for any model-mode promotion); [] for a deterministic promotion

compiler_version.description: the compiler that produced this unit (changing it changes unit_id — recompiles are attributable)

source_spec_hash.description: sha256 of the canonicalized (capability_record, task_spec, exec_target, policy) inputs — the same inputs always hash the same; a changed input is detectable

compiled_at.description: the timestamp PASSED IN by the caller (deterministic — the compiler never reads the clock)

rollback_target.description: the prior compiled unit_id this one supersedes (the reversible target), or '' when this is the first compile for the capability — lossless: a winner always names its predecessor

is_truth.description: structurally pinned false: a compiled unit is a deployable PLAN derived from gate evidence, not served truth. The FleetLedger / capability gate remain the source of truth.
